title: scanCacheTree
responsibility: Recursively inventories regular files beneath a cache path without following symlinks, returning byte totals and reasons for entries it cannot safely inspect.

inputs.name: scanCacheTree.path
inputs.description: Filesystem path to the cache file or directory to inventory.

outputs.name: scanCacheTree
outputs.description: WalkResult containing relative regular-file paths, total observed bytes when available, and protection or inspection reasons.
